description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Feed, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice, for detecting and handling feed (RSS/Atom) user agents within the Zend Framework's HTTP user agent parsing system.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Feed
classes.description: A class for identifying feed-type user agents, extending the abstract device class to implement specific matching and feature detection for feed readers.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if the user agent string matches known feed user agent signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'feed' in this class.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Sets features indicating the capabilities of feed user agents, such as no support for iframes, frames, or javascript.
